item.title: Box/Violin Plot
item.description:
title: “Box/Violin Plot” description: “Visualize data using either a Box Plot or a Violin Plot. Box plots are drawn as a box with a vertical line down the middle which is mean value, and has horizontal lines attached to each side (known as “whiskers”). Violin plots provide more detail by showing a smoothed density curve on each side, and also include a box plot inside for comparison.” category: “Statistical” operator_type: “BoxViolinPlot” tags: [visualization, statistical]

Home > Visualization > Statistical
